component.name: ReadAlong
component.summary: Audiobook player that highlights the text as the narrator reads

description.p: ReadAlong plays your audiobooks and shows the words as they are spoken. It makes the text itself with whisper.cpp, on the graphics card when there is one, and matches it to an EPUB of the same book when you have one.
Transcripts are saved beside each audiobook in the format the ReadAlong phone app reads, and listening positions sync with the phone the same way.
